title: Configuration Capture & Recall
research_boundary: Saved configurations are observations of instrument state, not proof of manuscript correspondence.

epistemic_status.observation: Local browser testing observed save, mutation, exact fingerprint recall, persistence across a full reload, export-ready state, and the first stage of the clear safety interlock. WXR-003 behavior on Quest awaits human testing.
epistemic_status.measurement: Slot A saved selected folio 2r at scale 1.10x with configuration fingerprint 6A35020C. A later scale 1.21x state produced fingerprint 1A9D253E. Loading slot A before and after a full reload restored fingerprint 6A35020C.
epistemic_status.inference: Within the tested state transition, the saved record and recalled current state produced the same deterministic 32-bit configuration fingerprint.

fingerprint_qualification: The configuration fingerprint is a deterministic change detector, not a cryptographic proof of uniqueness.
implemented: all WXR-002 independent-folio, free-grab, anchor-pivot, pointer, scale, opacity, depth, flip, and reset behavior
save and load of both 4x4 folio matrices and selected folio, opacity, scale, flip, mode, step, and anchor state
deterministic configuration fingerprint with integrity check on recall
JSON export payload containing current state, saved slots, timestamps, provenance references, and research boundary

observations: WXR-002 received an implicit human-reported Quest pass recorded separately in the append-only parent observation
